I'm adding many free the odds apis so the app can use them freely if they provide fresh odds.

I want the app and GitHub engine to smartly decide which apis to use and when and which apis to toggle off and on. it should have full control of api management. the api usage should be efficient but also use the best providers for accuracy and freshness, but also take full advantage of the few apis I pay for. the app should send me messages on which apis to purchase or refill free keys. the goal is a smart api manager that is autonomous and uses the best apis for their features and speed while also taking full advantage of my paid providers
